title: Administration
intro: Invite the educators who will run classrooms, see the state of every invitation you have issued, and move a classroom from one educator to another.

scope.heading: What this screen can and cannot reach
scope.body: You manage who may run a classroom, not what happens inside one. No learner account, project, figure, answer or photo is reachable from here or from anywhere you can navigate to — not because it is hidden, but because the database grants you no access to it. Of a classroom you can read its name and its current educator, which is exactly what you need to move it.
scope.noAdmins: There is also no way to create another administrator from inside the lab. The first one is put in place when the database is set up, and that is deliberate.

invite.heading: Invite an educator
invite.intro: Enter her email address and the lab will make a single-use code. You pass the code to her; she chooses her own password when she redeems it.
invite.emailHint: An adult's work address. This is the only contact detail the lab ever stores, and it is used for signing in and nothing else.
invite.shownOnce: This is the only time you will see the code. Only a scrambled version is stored, so it cannot be looked up again.
invite.mailSubject: Your invitation to the Explainable AI Lab
invite.mailBody:
Hello,

Here is your invitation code for the Explainable AI Lab: {{code}}

Go to the lab, choose "I have an invitation code", and enter it along with this email address. You will pick your own password.

The code works once and expires in {{hours}} hours.
invite.weSendNothing: The lab sends no email itself. That button opens your own mail app with the message ready — you press send, from your own address.
invite.noMailClient: If nothing opens, this device has no mail app set up. Copy the message instead and send it however you normally would.
invite.expiry: The code works once and expires in {{hours}} hours.

educators.heading: Educators ({{count}})
educators.empty: Nobody has redeemed an invitation yet.
educators.deactivateBody: She will no longer be able to sign in. You can find her here afterwards, but the lab has no way to switch her back on from this screen.
educators.deactivateKeepsWork: Her classrooms and everything her learners have made stay exactly as they are. Only her access ends — so move her classrooms to another educator first, or her group will have no adult who can see their progress.

invitations.heading: Invitations you have issued
invitations.empty: You have not issued any invitations yet.
invitations.caption: An educator's email address identifies her invitation. It appears here and nowhere a learner can see.

reassign.heading: Move a classroom
reassign.intro: If an educator leaves, move her classrooms to someone else so her group still has an adult who can see their progress.
reassign.cannotOpen: You cannot open a classroom, and there is nothing to click through to. A name and its current educator is all this screen is allowed to read.

failure.notAdministrator: Only an administrator can do that.
failure.badEmail: That does not look like an email address.
failure.lastAdministrator: You are the last administrator, so this account cannot be switched off. The program would have nobody left to run it. Invite and set up another administrator's access first.
failure.notAnEducator: A classroom can only go to an educator whose account is switched on.
failure.alreadyOwns: That classroom already belongs to that educator.
failure.unconfigured: This copy of the lab has no account service set up, so administration is unavailable.
failure.unknown: That did not work. Nothing was changed — try again.
